case_name: Anupam Sharma vs Nct Of Delhi And Anr.
facts_of_case: Husband prays that FIR No. 323/2002 under Section 498A/406/34 IPC be quashed. Wife prays that orders dated 25.1.2003 and 5.2.2003 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge be quashed.

legal_principles.principle: A compromise can be recorded in writing through a judicial order.
legal_principles.held: Prima facie the answer has to be in the affirmative. To read Order 23 Rule 3 to mean that unless a compromise is recorded in writing and signed by the parties it cannot be accepted by the Court would render otiose the phrase 'or where the defendant satisfies the plaintiff in respect of the whole or any part of the subject-matter of the Suit, the Court shall order such agreement, compromise or satisfaction to be recorded'.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure — Order 23 Rule 3

legal_principles.principle: A settlement agreement can be proved to the satisfaction of the Court through parole evidence.
legal_principles.held: The legislative intent is that it would be desirable to record a settlement agreement in writing but the same may even be proved to the satisfaction of the Court by parole evidence.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure — Order 23 Rule 3

outcome.final_order: The FIR No. 323/2002 under Section 498A/406/34 IPC was quashed.
